entries.subject: Thermal map at 15 um from the same ten JWST MIRI visits
entries.finding: c's dayside is measured and its day-night pattern is not. Its eclipse depth in the joint fit is 318 to 389 ppm (Bell's shape, a symmetric sinusoid, a free one), a 15 um brightness temperature of 353 to 379 K through the F1500W response and a BT-Settl 2600 K star; its four eclipse visits alone give 331 to 463 ppm. The phase curve does not constrain c: freed, the sinusoid runs to its bound (a pure sine, the peak 90 deg from noon); held symmetric, its amplitude fits to zero. A map would draw the assumed shape, so none is shown.
entries.revisitWhen: A phase curve of c that constrains its day-night contrast (a second visit, or a joint fit whose uncertainties converge), or a published map of c.
